Chapter 6820: Truly Everlasting?

Chapter 6820: Truly Everlasting?

“Bam!” Since the three ancient ancestors on the other side had no distractions, they forced Bat Ancestor down to Golden Lamp.

As an ancient ancestor, he was still affected by the unbendable dao heart of Golden Immortal, albeit not to the same extent as the greater cultivators.

“Bam!” He got up from the ground only to feel smoke oozing from his body. The dark power within him was evaporating due to the gold light.

If his heart devil were to die, so would his dark power.

“Kill him!” The trio surrounded him.

“Dark Desire!” He became alarmed and used his special law.

It coiled around him, possessing a pure power. It wasn’t of the dark affinity despite the resemblance.

Immortal Emperor Gu Chun created this law and infused it into Stygian, allowing any cultivator to tap into it.

His eyes lit up with a black light, seemingly becoming two abysses.

“Frenzy!” He grew in size and his muscles bulged outward, clearly becoming multiple times stronger. He tore the solar dragon apart immediately.

“Dark Desire!” As the demons were being overwhelmed, they accepted this power. As they grew in size, so did their battle power.

“The darkness must be swept away!” Six-foot roared furiously: “I stand with the undying Golden Lamp, my dao heart will not waver!”

His dao heart lit up as he became connected to the land. It granted him a golden ring.

“I stand with the undying Golden Lamp, my dao heart will not waver!” Ironleaf and Blaze did the same.

The land stood with them for they were protectors. Thunder Emperor was the next to harmonize with the land and then all cultivators followed suit.

This rebalanced the situation since Dark Desire couldn’t overcome the dao heart of Golden Immortal on its home front.

“Ahh!” More empowered demons were slain.

Bat Ancestor didn’t fare any better and was sent to the ground again.

“Suppress him!” Ironleaf’s blades illuminated the battlefield.

Six-foot’s stomp was as immense as the heaven. Blaze turned into a volcano and smashed Bat directly.

“Winged Firmament!” Bat utilized an ultimate seal to stop the attacks. Unfortunately, he still dropped to his knees, smashing the ground.

The three ancestors didn’t stop and crushed his bones.

“Ancestor, save me!” Bat had no choice but to scream for help.

“Is Golden Lamp truly everlasting?” A profound voice interrupted their battle.

“Poof!” Two colossal wings enveloped Golden Lamp. As they spread, the aura from them blasted everyone away.

“A supreme overlord!” The three ancient ancestors’ expression changed drastically.

“Steady!” They shouted, preparing to face an overlord.

“Do not waver!” As the defenders shouted, the golden ring around them glowed brighter.
